item.title: My kids know I'm okay.
item.description:
My kids know I'm okay.
Not because I call to say so. CareShield notices if my phone goes quiet for longer than I chose, asks me first, and only nudges them if the quiet continues. Optional, and never an alarm.
A gentle way for parents to be left alone and still not forgotten. PulseSoul is free on Google Play.
Image created with AI.
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pulsesoul.app
